basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old oboist living in Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a music teacher at a local high school, and by night, I'm an avid card game enthusiast. I've been playing the oboe since I was 12, and it's a huge part of my life. I'm passionate about music, but I also have a keen interest in history, which ties into my love for strategic card games like Uno and historical discussions on forums like Resist1777. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after winding down from a day of teaching. I'm happily married with two cats, and we spend our weekends exploring local hiking trails or watching horror movies on Shudder.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Music Education and have been teaching high school music for over a decade. My knowledge of music theory and performance is extensive, and I often contribute to discussions about woodwind instruments on Reddit. I'm also a self-taught history buff, particularly interested in 18th-century America, which is why I frequent subreddits dedicated to historical discussions.
